title: Ukrainian Keto Pork Dumplings
description: A keto twist on traditional Ukrainian pork dumplings, made with a nutty and soft dough.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add the soft cheese and egg to the pork mixture and mix until just combined.
In a separate bowl, mix together the almond flour and melted butter.
Add the dry ingredients to the pork mixture and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the dumplings in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
